lyn.name: Lyn
lyn.backstory: A swordswoman of the open plains from the warring continents beyond the southern straits, Lyndis turned down a noble title once and would do it again. She hates being cooped up, which is why she patrols the roof.

design.gear: a slim curved sword at her hip

unique.desc: A restless swordswoman who never tires of patrol.

rhea.backstory: Once the archbishop of a great church in the warring continents beyond the southern straits, and something far older than any archbishop. Rhea is serene, maternal and terrifying in equal measure. She claims she is here to tend the faithful.

manuela.backstory: A former opera diva and academy physician from the warring continents beyond the southern straits, Manuela is on the hunt for a husband and has a standing order at the bar. She can still bring a full house to tears with one aria.

design.features: a beauty mark beneath her eye

corrin.name: Corrin
corrin.backstory: Raised in a mountain fortress with a dragon's blood she barely understood, Corrin spent years torn between two homes. She came to Hollowmere to see the world she was never allowed to visit. She is gentle, curious, and surprisingly formidable when someone threatens her friends.

design.features: pointed ears, small sharp fangs and faint pale scales along her forearms
design.gear: an ornate long blade and a glowing dragonstone amulet

eirika.backstory: A princess who led her people through war and rebuilt a kingdom from ashes, Eirika is kind, brave and forever apologizing for things that were not her fault. She came to Hollowmere on a pilgrimage, and found the work warm and honest. She still stands as though a crown were on her head.

byleth.title: Professor
byleth.backstory: A mercenary who became a professor almost by accident, Byleth speaks little, notices everything and is quietly very good at both teaching and killing. She arrived in Hollowmere looking for work that did not involve a battlefield. She shows her feelings so rarely that a small smile is a gift.

celica.title: Princess
celica.backstory: A princess who left the safety of a convent and a kingdom to find her missing friend, Celica faced every hardship with a smile and a blessing.
